title: 第九十五章七彩谷的邀请第九十四章要不你喊两句
content_zh:
第九十五章，七彩谷的邀请！
刚刚走出婺城的冯老和宁美更是被秦风的这几句给镇到了。
好家伙，这小子是真不懂人情世故，还是假不懂？
居然用这种方式来让那些想见他的人难堪。
简直是天下奇才！！
“呵呵~”
“秦风啊秦风，这小子不光妖孽，还是十分有趣。”
“这下有意思了。”
“估计各方势力都没想到，他们等了这么久，居然会被秦风用这种方式给拒之门外。”
“哈哈哈！！”
冯老忍不住笑出声道。
而一旁的宁美则是极其无语道：“这秦风看似聪明，怎么会在这个时候犯下此等错误？他就不怕把各方势力都给得罪了？”
“都已经与龙家水火不相容了。”
“还真是个不知天高地厚的小子。”
冯老没有回应，而是面带微笑，踏步向前，朝着四方商会分会所在的方向走了过去。
宁美也只好跟上，但她心里清楚，估计婺城马上又要炸锅了......
当那些在客栈以及酒楼里休息的众多势力之人，听到秦风这番话后，先是目瞪口呆，随后怒气冲天。
“好嚣张的小子，居然当着整个婺城的面，将我们拒之门外。”
“难道他不知道，我可是三皇子殿下派来的？”
“是啊！这小子，太狂妄了吧？”

“真以为自己弄出了点战绩，就能如此跋扈？？”
“不知好歹！”
“哼，不见就不见，还想让我们一群人一起去见他，这简直是在赤裸裸的羞辱。”
“等了这么久，就等来这样一个结果？”
“可恶的小子！”
“老子定要回去在王爷面前，好好说道说道。”
“艹！”
“......”
一时之间，群起激愤。
凡是被派来见秦风的各方来人，无不感受到了羞辱。
要知道，平时他们去任何城市，见任何人，那都得被奉为座上宾，不光有好吃好喝的招待，还有好玩的~
可偏偏这一次，却在婺城栽了跟头。
content_en:
Chapter 95, invitation from Colorful Valley!
Mr. Feng and Ning Mei, who had just walked out of Wucheng, were stunned by Qin Feng's words.
Good guy, does this guy really not understand the ways of the world, or is he just pretending not to understand?
He actually used this method to embarrass those who wanted to see him.
He is simply a genius in the world! !
"Haha~"
"Qin Feng, Qin Feng, this kid is not only evil, but also very interesting."
"Now it's interesting."
"It is estimated that all the forces did not expect that after waiting for so long, they would be turned away by Qin Feng in this way."
"Hahaha!!"
Mr. Feng couldn't help laughing.
Ning Mei on the side was extremely speechless and said: "This Qin Feng seems smart, how could he make such a mistake at this time? Isn't he afraid of offending all the forces?"
"They are already incompatible with the Long family."
"He is really a naive boy."
Mr. Feng did not respond, but smiled and stepped forward in the direction of the Sifang Chamber of Commerce branch.
Ning Mei had no choice but to follow, but she knew in her heart that Wucheng was about to explode again...
When the many influential people resting in inns and restaurants heard Qin Feng's words, they were stunned at first, and then became furious.
"What an arrogant boy. He actually shut us out in front of the whole Wucheng."
"Don't he know that I was sent by His Highness the Third Prince?"
"Yes! Isn't this kid too arrogant?"
"Do you really think you can be so domineering just because you have some achievements??"
"I don't know what's wrong!"
"Huh, if you don't see him, you will see him. He wants a group of us to go see him together. This is simply a naked humiliation."
"After waiting for so long, you've got this result?"
"Damn boy!"
"I must go back and speak properly in front of the prince."
"grass!"
"..."
Suddenly, the crowd was furious.
Everyone who was sent to see Qin Feng felt humiliated.
You know, when they go to any city and meet anyone, they have to be treated as guests. Not only are they treated with delicious food and drinks, but they also have fun~
But this time, they stumbled in Wucheng.
